written.headline: ByteDance spins off AI drug discovery unit Anew Labs with $1.5B valuation
written.summary: ByteDance closed a $290 million funding round for its newly spun‑off AI drug discovery unit Anew Labs, valuing the company at $1.5 billion. ByteDance will retain a 56 % stake and the unit inherits core staff, algorithms and computing support from Volcano Engine.

written.headline: Anthropic opens wet lab in Bay Area to run AI‑directed biology experiments
written.summary: Anthropic has set up a wet biology lab in the San Francisco Bay Area where its AI models will direct robotic experiments, moving beyond computer‑only simulations. The lab operates like a typical biotech facility, combining in‑house work with external partners.

written.headline: Broadcom launches $60 billion debt syndication to fund Anthropic AI chips
written.summary: Broadcom is assembling a $60 billion debt package, with a $42 billion senior‑secured tranche and an $18 billion junior tranche led by Blackstone, to finance Anthropic’s AI‑chip purchases and infrastructure. The financing could be converted to equity and makes Anthropic Broadcom’s largest compute customer by 2027.

written.headline: Stanford builds virtual biotech with 37,000 AI agents for drug discovery
written.summary: Researchers at Stanford created a virtual biotech system comprising up to 37,000 AI scientist agents that analyze drug targets and design therapies. The system identified drug targets more likely to succeed in trials and proposed a lung‑cancer treatment later pursued by a major drugmaker.
